# #1200 · Purpose-built refusal fixture — a body with NO Created field

- **State:** open

**Summary:** This body deliberately omits the `- **Created:**` landmark so the migrator must
REFUSE it (T-Q1: a body with no real date cannot fill the required non-null `createdAt`, and no
timestamp is ever fabricated). Hand-authored fixture — never a copy of a live body.

**Context:** Exercises the "refuse a body with no Created" rule and the all-or-nothing whole-store
refusal (no partial write).
